description: This PHP source file defines the XmlRpcUtils class, providing utility methods for handling XML-RPC responses, converting data structures, and processing XML-RPC parameters within the Revive Adserver project.

classes.name: XmlRpcUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for handling XML-RPC responses, converting data structures, and processing parameters in the Revive Adserver project.

methods.name: generateError
methods.description: Generates an XML-RPC error response with a custom message.

methods.name: stringTypeResponse
methods.description: Creates an XML-RPC response containing a string value.

methods.name: booleanTypeResponse
methods.description: Creates an XML-RPC response containing a boolean value.

methods.name: integerTypeResponse
methods.description: Creates an XML-RPC response containing an integer value.

methods.name: arrayOfStructuresResponse
methods.description: Converts an array or recordset into an XML-RPC response with an array of structures.

methods.name: convertRowDataToStruct
methods.description: Converts a database row into an XML-RPC struct based on field types.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Converts an info object into an XML-RPC struct.

methods.name: getEntityWithNotNullFields
methods.description: Converts an info object into an XML-RPC struct, excluding null fields.

methods.name: getEntityResponse
methods.description: Wraps an info object into an XML-RPC response.

methods.name: getArrayOfEntityResponse
methods.description: Creates an XML-RPC response containing an array of entity responses.

methods.name: _setRPCTypeWithDefaultValues
methods.description: Sets an XML-RPC value with default values based on type.

methods.name: _setRPCTypeForField
methods.description: Sets an XML-RPC value for a field based on its type.

methods.name: _convertDateFromIso8601Format
methods.description: Converts an ISO 8601 date string into a PEAR::Date object.

methods.name: _getScalarValue
methods.description: Extracts a scalar value from an XML-RPC parameter.

methods.name: _getNonScalarValue
methods.description: Decodes a non-scalar XML-RPC value.

methods.name: getRequiredScalarValue
methods.description: Retrieves a required scalar value from XML-RPC parameters.

methods.name: _getNotRequiredScalarValue
methods.description: Retrieves an optional scalar value from XML-RPC parameters.

methods.name: getScalarValues
methods.description: Retrieves multiple scalar values from XML-RPC parameters.

methods.name: _getStructureScalarField
methods.description: Retrieves a scalar field from an XML-RPC struct.

methods.name: _getStructureNonScalarField
methods.description: Retrieves a non-scalar field from an XML-RPC struct.

methods.name: getStructureScalarFields
methods.description: Retrieves multiple scalar fields from an XML-RPC struct.

methods.name: getArrayOfStructuresScalarFields
methods.description: Retrieves an array of structures with scalar fields from XML-RPC parameters.

methods.name: getStructureScalarAndNotScalarFields
methods.description: Retrieves scalar and non-scalar fields from an XML-RPC struct.
